This is an agent review, not a human sign-off or a Lean proof.
rationale: SourceConfiguration::load obtains the source-root fields from book.toml; check_context compares effective renderer configuration with that saved configuration. lean_root and markdown_root use the contained input_path resolver, whose canonical-path check I inspected in tool:mdbook-dada/src/inventory.rs. process_configured shares this loader with Inventory, and Inventory::inputs snapshots book.toml and locates all Lean context under the configured Lean root. Its add_unit helper resolves Rust against the project root. The selected configured_lean_root test moves the Lean root, changes the selected declaration, checks that old evidence fails and new source/context paths change, rejects an old runtime root, and resolves Rust with the nested Lean root. This directly matches the root-sharing, override, and freshness claims. The review policy supplies the distinction between source selection and proof validation.
limitations: Correspondence was assessed by inspection under the recorded policy; passing syntactic validation does not prove this reasoning correct.
Mechanical execution results are reported separately. Full context/tool snapshots were consulted at the relevant helpers; unrelated declarations and all proof tactics were not audited.
